preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 50000, inclusive.
The old and new capital indices r1 and r2 are different and within the range of city indices.
The old representation list contains n - 1 elements, one for each non-capital city.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= n for pi in old_representation)
preconditions.description: Each element in the old representation list is a valid city index within the range of city indices.

postconditions.description: The new representation list contains n - 1 elements, one for each non-capital city.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= ni <= n for ni in new_representation)
postconditions.description: Each element in the new representation list is a valid city index within the range of city indices.

postconditions.expression: all(new_representation[i] != new_representation[j] for i in range(n - 1) for j in range(i + 1, n - 1))
postconditions.description: Each city in the new representation list is a unique index and is different from the new capital index r2.

postconditions.expression: all(new_representation[i] == r2 or new_representation[i] == pi for i in range(n - 1))
postconditions.description: For each city i, the new representation of the road map contains the index of the last city on the way from the new capital to city i.
